title: SEGA Graph Edges
description: Array of edge (relationship) objects for the SEGA studio graph visualization. Each edge connects two nodes.

from.description: Source node ID (must reference an existing node in nodes.json)

to.description: Target node ID (must reference an existing node in nodes.json)

label.description: Relationship type displayed on the edge

title.description: Optional tooltip text (defaults to label if omitted)
